flags.finding: Bookmaker odds never appear in the OLBG pages we retrieved. The listings print the selection, market, tip split and percentage, but the price column is empty, and event pages show 'WIN @' with nothing after it. The prices are rendered client-side.
flags.impact: We cannot quote or check market prices, so the whole board is priced by us (CAL-1/CAL-2) and the -250 to +10000 band is applied to our own numbers. Any statement about 'market prices' would be unverifiable, so none is made.

flags.finding: The OLBG handball listing shows 'Tie' as the most-popular pick for 11 of the 15 events, including matches where one side is a heavy favourite (Magdeburg v Kriens, PSG v Aalborg, Skanderborg v Barcelona). A 62% share of tips on draws across the whole Champions League round is not credible.
flags.impact: Handball splits are unusable. Those picks use CAL-2 (published EHF favourite base rate, 446/654 = 68.2%) instead, and no 'Tie' pick is published. Worth reporting to OLBG if the pattern persists.

flags.finding: Players Championship 31 shows Nathan Aspinall at 1/3 (33%) on the sport listing but 1/4 (25%) on the event page for the same market. The event page also splits the four tips across van Veen, Aspinall, Doets and 'Other'.
flags.impact: We use the event-page figure (1/4) because it is the more granular view, and the pick is labelled medium/low accordingly.

flags.finding: OLBG prints no timezone and several of its times disagree with the governing body: Glasgow Warriors v Lions is 15:45 on OLBG against 19:45 UK on URC.tv; Djokovic v Humbert is 28 Oct 06:00 on OLBG, the ATP page says Wednesday 28 October and two other outlets say Tuesday 27 October at 12:00 local; Montes Claros v Cruzeiro is 22:00 on OLBG against 18:30 on the CBV's official table (19:00 Brasilia); New Zealand v India 3rd T20 is 03:00 on OLBG against 07:00 GMT (20:00 local) on ESPNcricinfo; the greyhound races are labelled 8:24, 8:36, 8:34 in the race name but 16:24, 16:36, 16:34 in OLBG's start column.
flags.impact: Every time on this site is quoted exactly as OLBG printed it and is not treated as a settled kick-off time. Where an official time was retrieved it is given in the fact list on the pick card. Do not assume any OLBG time is UK time.

flags.finding: MIN Timberwolves @ CLE Cavaliers shows a 9/16 split on the Basketball listing and 9/17 on the event page, one hour apart on the same day.
flags.impact: Tip totals on OLBG move as tips arrive, so a split is a snapshot, not a fixed number. Our price uses the listing snapshot and is therefore only valid at the stated retrieval time.

flags.finding: Both https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Snooker/8 and the all-events variant return 'No tips found', and the sport filter on the page renders as 'All Sports' rather than 'Snooker'. Search-engine captures from mid-October do show snooker tips, so the page is capable of listing them.
flags.impact: Zero snooker events and zero snooker picks. The most likely cause is the gap after the Northern Ireland Open final on 25 October, but the filter rendering wrongly suggests a page-level problem we cannot fix from outside. No line is originated where there is no market.

flags.finding: The Rugby League World Cup is in progress (England v Papua New Guinea on 30 October, Tonga v Samoa on 1 November) yet OLBG's Rugby League page carries only three season ante-post markets and no match-level tips.
flags.impact: Three rugby league picks instead of five, all long-dated ante-post. The live World Cup fixtures are listed on the site as verified events but cannot be priced from OLBG data.

flags.finding: Only one MLB game (World Series Game 3) carried any tips, with two markets. The MLB sub-page documents Money Line, Run Line and Game Totals, but only Money Line and Over/Under had selections.
flags.impact: Two baseball picks, not five. Run Line could not be priced.

flags.finding: Golf carries three tournament outrights, each with a 1/2 split and no comments. There are no match-play or round markets with tips.
flags.impact: Three golf picks, all low confidence. A two-tip market cannot support a stronger label.

flags.finding: Searches for 'New Zealand vs India 3rd T20' return a January 2026 match played in Guwahati. The OLBG event is a different fixture, the third T20I of India's 2026-27 tour of New Zealand at Wellington.
flags.impact: The Guwahati scorecard was read only to rule it out. Only the October 2026 preview is cited as evidence for the pick. Anyone auditing should check they are on the right series.

flags.finding: The Group F table we could reach lists Magdeburg and Kielce records in full but does not show Kriens Luzern or Kolstad columns with values. Those two opponents' group records are therefore unconfirmed.
flags.impact: Two handball picks (Magdeburg, Kielce) are priced as ordinary home favourites rather than as mismatches, and both are capped at medium confidence. The blank is deliberate.

flags.finding: The RTE round-three guide used for Ulster's and Munster's form is dated 8 October 2026, two rounds before the fixtures we are pricing (29-31 October).
flags.impact: Ulster in particular may have won since. The Ulster pick is low confidence and the note is marked stale on the card.

flags.area: Rugby Union - secondary source for standings
flags.finding: URC standings after three rounds come from a Wikipedia season page, not from unitedrugby.com. The figures are internally consistent (played, won, drawn, lost, points) but a secondary source is not an official one.
flags.impact: The two URC picks that rely on the table (Glasgow, Connacht) should be re-checked against the official URC table before any staking decision.

flags.finding: OLBG runs Gaelic Football (sport id 25) and Hurling (sport id 26) as two separate sports. The brief lists 'Gaelic Sports' as one.
flags.impact: Both pages are inventoried and combined under one Gaelic Sports page, with the sport id shown for each event so the split is visible.

flags.finding: 19 of the 56 written predictions rest on four tips or fewer, and 9 rest on a single tip. OLBG's own sample sizes, not our selection, cause this.
flags.impact: Those rows are labelled low or medium and are priced close to even money by the shrinkage step. They are published for completeness, not as conviction bets.

flags.finding: One aggregator describes Djokovic v Humbert as 'Basel, 1/16 round' while the ATP describes it as the first round of the 32-player draw at the Swiss Indoors Basel.
flags.impact: We use the ATP wording: Swiss Indoors Basel, first round. The aggregator's round label is not repeated.

flags.finding: No form, injury or squad source was retrieved for the five handball fixtures we priced. The EHF club pages are behind a competition site we could not read, and the OLBG splits on this sport are unusable (F-002).
flags.impact: All five handball prices are fixture-level estimates labelled CAL-2 and capped at medium. They are the weakest rows on the board and should be re-priced against the EHF match centre before any stake.

flags.finding: Nine published selections sit in outright or tournament markets (three golf, two darts, four Gaelic, two rugby league, one motor racing) where the number of runners is not printed and the tip sample is between one and thirty-six tips.
flags.impact: These rows carry an explicit probability rather than a repriced split, and are labelled CAL-3 on the page. They are honest estimates, not market-derived prices, and every one of them is labelled low confidence except where noted.

flags.area: Coverage gap - seven sports short of the five-pick target
flags.finding: Golf (3), Darts (2), Baseball (2), Gaelic Sports (4), Motor Racing (2), Rugby League (3) and Snooker (0) cannot reach five picks. Between them OLBG lists 16 events, several of them season outrights a year away, and one entire sport with no tips at all.
flags.impact: 56 predictions were published against a 75-pick target. The shortfall is named on the dashboard and on each sport page rather than filled with invented fixtures. Closing it needs either a licensed odds feed or the official fixture lists of each competition, neither of which OLBG exposes.

flags.finding: The event inventory, originating lines and written predictions on the primary board were captured/generated on 2026-10-26. This repository update did not re-fetch the OLBG event pages, so current fixture availability, start times, markets and prices are not established. Relative labels such as “Today” and “Tomorrow” refer to the capture date, not the present date.
flags.impact: Treat the primary board as an archive, not an actionable current card. Re-open the official OLBG hub and event page and re-check official team/competition sources before using any entry. The dashboard and every generated page link to the snapshot freshness audit; no new picks were invented to imply current coverage.

blanks: No bookmaker prices are quoted anywhere on this site, because none could be read from OLBG. Every price shown is ours.
Handball: no 'Tie' selections are published and no handball split is used, because the printed splits look like a display defect.
Handball: Kriens Luzern's and Kolstad's group records are left blank rather than estimated.
Snooker: no events, no lines, no picks - OLBG returned no tips.
Gaelic club matches: no team news or form data was available from an official source, so those two picks make no claim about players, injuries or recent results.
Volleyball, Handball, Greyhounds and Darts picks make no injury claims; no official team-news source exists for those fixtures at this level.
No weather, referee, surface-speed or travel-distance numbers are stated unless a source link on the same card supports them.
Rugby League World Cup fixtures (England v PNG 30 Oct, Lebanon v France 1 Nov, Tonga v Samoa 1 Nov) are listed as confirmed events but are not priced, because OLBG carries no market for them.
